question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

a low of land between hills
solution:
The correct answer is "**valley**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
 
• **plateau**: an area of fairly level high ground.
 
• **beach: **a pebbly or sandy shore, especially by the sea between high- and low-water marks.
 
• **gulf: **a deep inlet of the sea almost surrounded by land, with a narrow mouth.
 
• **valley: **a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of given words,** "valley" **is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **Example**: *The sound of the stream flowing through the **valley **__was soothing.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
 
• **plateau:**** **काफी स्तर की ऊँची जमीन का क्षेत्र।
 
• **beach:**** **एक कंकड़ या रेतीला किनारा, विशेष रूप से समुद्र के द्वारा उच्च और निम्न-पानी के निशान के बीच।
 
• **gulf:**** **एक संकीर्ण मुँह के साथ, लगभग भूमि से घिरा समुद्र का एक गहरा प्रवेश।
 
• **valley:**** **पहाड़ियों या पहाड़ों के बीच भूमि का एक निचला क्षेत्र, आमतौर पर इसके माध्यम से बहने वाली नदी या धारा के साथ।
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of given words,** "valley" **is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
